# Cristian David Rojas Carvajal

> Software Developer specialized in Shopify & VTEX IO | Colombia / Malta

## About

Web developer with over five years in technology and four+ years focused on e-commerce and frontend development. Specializes in building scalable Shopify storefronts, custom VTEX IO applications, and high-performance web interfaces using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL.

## Skills

- Shopify: Liquid, Shopify CLI, Checkout Extensibility, Shopify Functions, Hydrogen, Admin & Storefront API, Online Store 2.0, Metafields, OAuth, Webhooks
- VTEX IO: IO Builder, Store Framework, Custom Apps, GraphQL API, OMS & Master Data integrations, Checkout Customization, GA4 tracking
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Sass
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL, MongoDB
- Analytics & SEO: Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Technical SEO
- Cloud & Tools: AWS (Lambda, S3, Serverless), Docker, Git
